issue.title: parse_date raises KeyError with custom format
issue.body:
Since updating to the latest version, passing a custom format fails.

### Steps to reproduce
```python
from datekit import parse_date
parse_date("01/02/2024", fmt="%d/%m/%Y")
```

### Error
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "repro.py", line 2, in <module>
    parse_date("01/02/2024", fmt="%d/%m/%Y")
  File "datekit/core.py", line 88, in parse_date
    pattern = FORMATS[fmt]
KeyError: '%d/%m/%Y'
```

This worked before I upgraded.
